Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly inferred the birthplace of Antonio Vivaldi as "Burano" based on the fact that he was born in the Venetian Lagoon, without verifying the specific city of birth. While Vivaldi was indeed born in Venice (specifically in the sestiere of Cannaregio), not Burano, the Planner hallucinated the location. This error led to the selection of the wrong famous bridge ("Tre Ponti" in Burano) instead of the correct one in Venice (e.g., Rialto Bridge). The Planner failed to cross-reference the general region (Venetian Lagoon) with the specific city of birth before proceeding to the next step of finding a bridge.
